description: Create an Airflow DAG for iot_fleet that ingests device telemetry batches whose payload schema version varies by firmware. The DAG should: (1) read the batch manifest and extract schema_version, (2) branch to 'parse_v1', 'parse_v2', or 'parse_v3'; unknown versions route to 'quarantine_batch', (3) all parsers write to a common normalized staging table, (4) 'load_to_warehouse' runs after any parser, (5) 'quarantine_batch' moves the batch to a quarantine prefix and pages on-call, and the DAG run must end as failed. A manifest can list more than one schema version, in which case all matching parsers must run.
edge_cases: Mixed batches (v1 and v3 in the same manifest) must run both parsers; an unknown version alongside known ones must quarantine only the unknown files and still fail the run
schema_version may be an integer or a string ('2' vs 2) in the manifest; comparison must normalize the type
v1 payloads lack the battery_pct field: parsers must emit NULL, not 0
v3 renamed 'temp' to 'temperature_c'; the normalized column must be populated from whichever exists
common_failure_modes: FM5: Parser fills missing v1 fields with 0, corrupting battery averages downstream
FM6: Unknown version falls through to the latest parser instead of quarantine
FM6: load_to_warehouse uses all_success and is skipped whenever fewer than three parsers run
